description: This file defines the interface IAppManager within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares nested notification interface for app lifecycle events, methods for managing apps (launch, load, close, terminate, etc.), and properties related to app management, such as maximum apps and resource limits.

classes.name: IAppManager
classes.description: Interface for managing applications, including lifecycle management, property access, and notification registration.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving app lifecycle event notifications such as installation, uninstallation, state changes, and launch requests.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification listener for app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification listener for app events.

methods.name: GetLaunchableApps
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator of launchable applications.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator of currently loaded applications.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launches an application with specified intent and arguments.

methods.name: LoadApp
methods.description: Loads an application into memory.

methods.name: PrepareApp
methods.description: Prepares an application, potentially for launch.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified app.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes a specified app.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Terminates a specified app.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clears stored data of the specified app.

methods.name: SetAppFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the specified app.

methods.name: GetAppMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an app.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value of an app.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value for an app.

methods.name: SetMaxInactiveApps
methods.description: Sets maximum number of inactive apps.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveApps
methods.description: Retrieves maximum number of inactive apps.

methods.name: SetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Sets maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Retrieves maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: SetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Sets maximum flash usage for hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Retrieves maximum flash usage for hibernated apps.

methods.name: SetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Sets maximum RAM usage for inactive apps.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Retrieves maximum RAM usage for inactive apps.

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^  struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
